about: Health monitor (bullets). It watches that the app is really collecting data during market hours and tells you on Telegram (and on the System page) when something stops: the Mac slept or the app froze (gap_alert_s), the live scanner isn't running when it should (scanner_down_min), the day's recording stopped growing (recording_stall_min), errors pile up (errors_10min), the disk is getting full (disk_warn_gb) or the Mac runs on battery (battery_warn). keep_awake: while the market is open (keep_awake_from - keep_awake_to on trading days) the app asks macOS not to sleep when idle (the built-in 'caffeinate' command, ended after the close; closing the lid still sleeps a MacBook). daily_summary_at: one message after the close with what was recorded. holidays: NSE trading holidays (dated; add next year's list when NSE publishes it), so nothing nags you on a holiday.
